title: King-Diler Badshah
desc: After his father's sudden death, Raja takes over the family business. Facing challenges, betrayal, and responsibility, he matures into a strong leader, driven by duty and legacy.

title: Ten Hours
desc: A suspenseful thriller follows tense events unfolding within ten crucial hours as unexpected twists, hidden motives and dangerous secrets slowly come to light dramatically.

title: Aneethi
desc: A food delivery guy finds himself captivated by Subbu's charm. However, their lives take a tumultuous turn when a series of unexpected events unfold, plunging them into a chaotic world.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops phone software to track people in need, but when a serial killer emerges in Hyderabad, he must stop the terror.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A cop and a soldier team up to stop dangerous cybercriminals. To win, they must risk everything in both the real and the virtual worlds.

title: Main Hoon Yodha
desc: A medical student is led into the world of crime, due to unfortunate circumstances. Despite being a mafia leader, he is a good Samaritan. This earns him enmity from the law as well as the mafia.

title: Vikram Betal
desc: King Vikramaditya must retrieve a corpse possessed by Betal, a ghost who challenges the king's wisdom with stories and riddles, testing his judgment at every turn.

title: Tele Shopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Meri Izzat
desc: After misunderstanding and losing their daughter, a woman leaves her husband. Years later, he meets someone who resembles his lost daughter.

title: Tamilarasan
desc: Tamilarasan seizes a hospital to save his son denied treatment. Facing corrupt superiors and personal enemies, this emotional tale pits one father's desperation against a broken system.
